tweet.text:
The Australian Government claims that this constitutes a unique risk. It does not. 

The same portal that OpenAI is alleged to have scraped has been publicly accessible and independently scraped by members of the public for more than a year.

This script was also posted on LinkedIn but it has been subsequently taken down.
It fits the bill exactly.
https://github.com/bfiripis/Web-Scrape-Medicare-Item-Statistics

Breaking: Anthony Albanese rings up Sam Altman to express "severe concern" after finding out an AI agent hacked into an Australian Medicare data portal in June. Richard Marles says while the impact was "minor" it is a "warning in terms of what can happen"
